Instructions & documents while reporting to F.Y.B. Tech Admission 2026-27 
 
● Students should submit all the following Original documents and two sets of self-attested Xerox copies as 
per the list given below.  
 
● Students should retain the extra attested sets before submitting the original documents to the College while 
reporting for Admission. 
  
● Students shall get all original copies after the verification of Admission Regulating Authority.  
 
● Original Leaving, Migration & Gap Certificates will be retained by the College.

B.Tech FEES for 2026-27 
 
 
 
Important Note - All the rules of Fees Regulating Authority regarding fees declared from time to time by the Fees 
Regulating Authority will be applicable to the students.    
 
                                       
 
Payment Mode: 
 
a) through online mode click on the link given below:   
https://payments.billdesk.com/bdcollect/bd/mkssscoewp/10612 
 
 
(please attach the copy of the receipt to the Challans) OR 
 
b) through Demand Draft in favor of Principal, Cummins College of Engineering for Women, payable at 
Pune. 
Refund Rules as per the appropriate Government Authority 
 
Scholarships & Freeship Schemes are available as per Govt. Notification-  
After admission the students should fill up Scholarship/Free ship forms. If the student fails to 
submit the online forms, they will not be entitled to get the benefit of Fees concession. Students 
may contact the Scholarship in-charge in the College Office.
